basis: Asthma is an immune-mediated inflammatory airway disease; environmental irritants can trigger nonallergic airway inflammation.

decisions.infectious_immune: primary: nonallergic asthma still involves immune-mediated airway inflammation; an allergic mechanism is not required.

basis: Glycogen metabolic disorder; liver dysfunction 80-99%, myopathy and dilated cardiomyopathy each 30-79%. Neurologic disease varies by subtype; nonspecific skin findings lack demonstrated damage.

decisions.hepatic: involved: liver dysfunction occurs in 80-99%, but this umbrella includes nonhepatic forms and is defined by the glycogen metabolic defect.

basis: Congenital epidermal keratinization disorder; ectropion impairs eyelid function and is reported in 1/1 assessed patient. The small denominator limits confidence in its prevalence.

decisions.ocular: involved: ectropion is a structural eyelid defect, reported in 1/1 assessed patient; use the supplied frequency with uncertainty from the small sample.

basis: Inherited vascular malformations define HHT; recurrent epistaxis from nasal vascular lesions is a major diagnostic criterion. HHT4-specific pulmonary AVM and cerebral injury frequencies are unknown.

decisions.pulmonary: involved: recurrent bleeding from nasal mucosal telangiectasias is a major diagnostic criterion; the pulmonary axis includes the nose.

basis: Mesomelic skeletal dysplasia with limb malformations; pendular nystagmus in 2/2 does not establish intrinsic ocular damage or a defined neurologic lesion.

decisions.ocular: none: nystagmus in 2/2 establishes abnormal eye movements, but does not establish direct damage to the eye or its supporting structures.

basis: UV-induced skin injury defines XP-D; neurodegeneration affects roughly half and cumulative ocular surface injury exceeds 30%. Individual ocular lesions are 5-29%; hearing frequency is uncertain.

decisions.ocular: involved: cumulative UV-related ocular surface injury exceeds approximately 30%; frequencies of 5-29% for individual lesions do not represent total ocular involvement.

basis: Inherited apoA-I amyloid nephropathy; hepatic deposition often preserves function. Function-impairing hepatic, cardiac and nerve involvement varies by variant without an established >=30% frequency.

decisions.hepatic: none: hepatic amyloid deposits do not necessarily impair function; clinically damaging liver involvement in >=30% is not established.

basis: Severe neonatal MADD commonly causes fatty hepatopathy, cardiomyopathy and cystic renal dysplasia, approximately >=30% each. Neurologic injury is less quantified and omitted at the four-axis cap.

decisions.renal: involved: cystic renal dysplasia is characteristic of the severe neonatal form with congenital anomalies and occurs in approximately >=30%.
decisions.neurologic: none: encephalopathy occurs, but lasting neurologic injury frequency is uncertain; characteristic renal, hepatic and cardiac disease take priority within the cap.

basis: Cardiomyopathy and congenital cardiac defects define the phenotype; cutis laxa occurs in 10/19 and ptosis in 3/6. Intellectual disability 4/18 and sternal anomalies 5/19 are below 30%.

decisions.ocular: involved: congenital ptosis is a structural eyelid dysfunction, reported in 3/6 patients (50%); eyelids belong to the ocular axis.

basis: Tumour originates in parasympathetic chemosensory paraganglia of the aortic body. Adjacent heart and vessels are not its tissue of origin; endocrine dysfunction is not defining.

decisions.neurologic: primary: the tumour arises in parasympathetic aortic-body paraganglia, part of the peripheral chemosensory nervous system.
decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: neuroendocrine histology alone does not establish origin in a hormone-producing endocrine organ or a defining metabolic disorder.
